name: gizza-ai/invoice-generator
summary: Generate a printable PDF invoice from line items

tool.description: Turn line items into a formatted, printable PDF invoice (returned for download). items is one per line: 'description | quantity | unit_price'. Optionally set seller (From), client (Bill To), invoice_number, date, tax_rate (percent), currency, and notes. The subtotal, tax, and total are computed automatically. Returns a one-page PDF. Runs locally.

items.description: Line items, one per line as 'description | quantity | unit_price' (e.g. 'Design work | 10 | 75').

seller.description: Your name/company and address (the 'From' block); newlines allowed.

client.description: The customer's name and address (the 'Bill To' block); newlines allowed.

tax_rate.description: Tax rate as a percentage applied to the subtotal (default 0).
